title: Amazon Autos is coming to the UK—the first country outside the US
summary: UK customers will be able to browse real-time dealer inventory, see upfront pricing, get an instant trade-in valuation, and connect with a local dealer—all on Amazon.co.uk.
body_markdown:
---


## Key takeaways


- Amazon Autos is coming to the UK in early 2027, its first launch outside of the United States.


- Hyundai is the first new car brand announced, with more to follow ahead of launch.


- UK customers will be able to browse dealer inventory, see upfront pricing, get an instant trade-in valuation, connect with a local dealer, and reserve a car.


---


[Amazon Autos](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/how-to-buy-a-car-with-amazon-autos) is launching in the United Kingdom, the first time the service has expanded beyond the United States.


Amazon Autos—a service offering new, used, and certified pre-owned vehicles—


[launched in the U.S. in December 2024](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-autos-buy-car-online) and has grown from 48 cities to more than 150, selling vehicles from 35 brands.


Building on our experience in the U.S., we're launching Amazon Autos in the UK, designed to fit how UK customers research, compare, and shop for cars.


[Amazon Autos now offers used and certified pre-owned vehicles](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-autos-buy-car-online)


Customers can shop for quality pre-owned vehicles online in a shopping experience they know and trust.


## When will Amazon Autos launch in the UK?


Amazon Autos will launch in the UK in early 2027, allowing customers to browse real-time dealer inventory, see upfront pricing, get an instant trade-in valuation, connect with a local dealer, and reserve a car —all on Amazon.


“The response in the U.S. has been clear: customers appreciate a simpler way to buy a car,” said Fan Jin, global leader of Amazon Autos. “We're bringing that same transparency, choice, and simplicity to the UK.”


## Which brands will be available on Amazon Autos in the UK?


Hyundai is the first new car brand to be announced as a launch partner in the UK.


Building on our partnership of innovation in the U.S., Hyundai will bring a broad lineup to Amazon.co.uk from day one. The selection will include electric, hybrid, and petrol vehicles, giving shoppers the flexibility to choose the powertrain, body style, and technology that best suits their lifestyle. The range will include Hyundai’s award-winning IONIQ family, including IONIQ 3 and IONIQ 5, alongside popular models i20 and KONA, helping customers explore everything from efficient family SUVs to advanced electric vehicles in one convenient place.


[For more news, visit About Amazon UK](https://www.aboutamazon.co.uk/)


Amazon is guided by four principles: customer obsession rather than competitor focus, passion for invention, commitment to operational excellence, and long-term thinking. This is our story.


Between now and launch in early 2027, we'll announce additional brands and dealer partners.


“Buying a car is one of the biggest purchases people make, and we think it should feel as simple and transparent as shopping for anything on Amazon,” said Matt Nuffort, director of Amazon Autos International.


“In the UK, that means making it easy for customers to browse real inventory, see upfront pricing, reserve the car, and connect with the dealer to finalize the purchase. We worked closely with UK dealers to design the experience, and they’re excited that we’re bringing them customers who are ready to buy. Today, we're happy to announce the expansion of our partnership with Hyundai as our first UK launch partner, and we’ll be announcing more brands between now and the launch in early 2027.”

[how U.S. customers can buy a car with Amazon Autos](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/how-to-buy-a-car-with-amazon-autos) .
